messages:
nora: Quick sync  prelaunch SEO for the webinar + launch posts. Need a tiny ops checklist: keyword groups, JSON-LD, internal anchors, redirect heatmap, and inbound routing. Who takes what?

felix: I can do keyword grouping + anchor text plan. Proposed anchors: "Register", "Read the benchmark", "Starter kit". Also create keyword buckets: product-intent, benchmark-intent, howto-intent. Will upload CSV.

maria: I'll own structured data. Recommend Event + FAQPage + HowTo (for starter kit snippets). Will hand over CMS-ready JSON-LD. Example Event snippet I'll add: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Serving at scale","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```

ben: Tracking/routing: set utm_content values: webinar_cta / bench_cta / kit_cta. Map webinar_cta -> Sales A queue, bench_cta -> nurture stream. Persist UTM through redirects with session cookie. TY pages = noindex.

felix: Redirect heatmap idea: list top 20 legacy URLs -> new canonical, surface any >1-hop chains. Sample nginx rules: 
```
# direct 301
rewrite ^/old-post/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# experiment routes use 302
rewrite ^/exp/launch-beta/(.*)$ /exp-landing/$1 redirect;
```
I'll flag which rules are permanent.

maria: Also add BreadcrumbList and `mainEntity` FAQ on the benchmark post. Consider HowTo schema for the starter kit to appear in rich results.

nora: Internal linking: add 2 contextual links from product docs and 3 from benchmark/insights content to the canonical landing. Keep anchors short and consistent. Do not link to TY pages.

ben: GA events: `cta_click`, `register_attempt`, `register_complete`. Send event payload to BigQuery with utm_content included. Also add server-side ping when form submits so CRM sees the source.

crawl-bot: Preview build ready: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-orbit-preview - running staging crawl and structured data validator.

felix: After crawl I'll extract redirect chains. If any chain >1 hop, we'll flatten to single 301s to preserve link equity. I'll drop the CSV in the ticket: https://linear.app/RW/issue/MKT-998

maria: ETA for JSON-LD snippets: 4pm today. I'll paste them in the CMS PR for review.

nora: Ownership recap: felix = keywords + redirects + anchor plan; maria = schema + JSON-LD; ben = UTMs + routing + analytics; nora = signoff + CRO experiments. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to review crawl output. :calendar:
